title: BioIVT: diagnosis questions become a type-ahead SNOMED CT lookup
description: Turns five free-text diagnosis questions (donor diagnosis, specimen diagnosis on Follow-up, Outcome and Oncology, confirmed diagnosis) into a type-ahead lookup over real SNOMED CT concept ids. DEMONSTRATION list: real codes, partial, not clinically reviewed; licences to be confirmed before real use.
rationale: Option C: diagnoses coded to SNOMED CT at the point of entry.
source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 2 build for the client demonstration.
